creative_improvements.idea: EXTREME regime confidence boost — increase CONF_FILTER_MIN to 75 for EXTREME entries, reduce to 65 for NORMAL
creative_improvements.rationale: EXTREME regime: 139T/59%WR/+$2.96. NORMAL: 81T/53.1%WR/-$2.43. The system already filters better in EXTREME. We should let MORE signals fire in EXTREME (lower bar) and FEWER in NORMAL (higher bar). Current CONF_FILTER_MIN=70 is one-size-fits-all.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Could capture 15-20% more EXTREME trades (+$0.45-0.60/7d) while reducing NORMAL noise (-$0.30-0.50/7d saved). Net: +$0.75-1.10/7d.
creative_improvements.risk: low — only affects confidence threshold per regime, no structural change

creative_improvements.idea: cut-loser-CL-T1 activation delay — skip first 5 minutes, let ATR_SL manage initial drawdown
creative_improvements.rationale: cut-loser-CL-T1 exits avg -$0.177/trade (0% WR, 6T/24h). These fire on 1% loss immediately. But ATR_SL exits avg -$0.033 with 52.6% WR. The problem: cut-loser fires BEFORE ATR_SL can manage. If we add a 5-minute delay, ATR_SL gets a chance to trail or hit TP first. 48h data: ATR_SL is actually profitable at scale (19T 52.6% WR).
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Reduce cut-loser-CL-T1 exits by ~50%. Save ~$0.50/24h. Some will become ATR_SL exits (manageable) or profit-monster-trail wins.
creative_improvements.risk: medium — some positions may drawdown further before cut-loser fires. Needs backtest.

creative_improvements.idea: mover- SHORT position sizing boost — 2.38 R:R, 85.7% WR, only 7T/7d
creative_improvements.rationale: mover- has the best R:R in the system (2.38) with 85.7% WR. But only 7 trades in 7d. It's signal-starved. If we add it to STANDALONE_BYPASS or lower its confidence threshold, it could fire more often without sacrificing quality.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: If mover- doubles from 7T to 14T/7d at same R:R: +$0.40/7d additional profit.
creative_improvements.risk: low — mover- already proven, just needs more opportunities

creative_improvements.idea: pullback-entry- SHORT R:R improvement — widen RR engine resistance by 0.1%
creative_improvements.rationale: pullback-entry- is the #1 profitable signal (29T/69%WR/+$1.93/7d) but rr_engine_resistance exits cost -$0.60. 12 SHORT trades hit resistance and reversed. Widening the resistance band by 0.1% would let some of these trades run to TP instead of exiting at support.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: If 50% of rr_engine_resistance exits become TP exits: +$0.30/7d.
creative_improvements.risk: low — only affects exit threshold, not entry
